raw.details:
TiH Hackathon – Physical AI: From Simulation to Reality

Building Intelligent Systems That Perceive, Decide, and Act in the Real World.

Get ready to turn your ideas into reality!

The TiH Hackathon, presented as part of E-Summit’26 at IIT Bombay, challenges undergraduate students and early-stage startups to solve real-world problems using AI-driven robotics and IoT.

Participants will embark on a journey from developing intelligent algorithms in simulation environments to demonstrating their solutions on actual robots and physical IoT devices.

Prize Pool

₹1,50,000

Competition Timeline

  • Round 1 – Online Submission: Submit your solution online by 26th November 2026, 11:59 PM.
  • Shortlisting: All submissions will be evaluated by an expert jury. The shortlisted teams advancing to the Grand Finale will be announced after the first round of submissions.
  • Grand Finale – 12th & 13th December 2026: The selected finalists will compete at E-Summit’26, IIT Bombay, showcasing their solutions through physical prototypes and live demonstrations.

Problem Tracks

Participants can choose from seven problem tracks:

  • IoT in Agriculture
  • Warehouse Automation
  • AI for Sustainability / Green Tech
  • AI in Water Management
  • Disaster Management (Robotics + AI)
  • Robot-Assisted Manufacturing
  • AI / IoT in Healthcare

Round 1 Submission Requirements

Each team must submit:

  • A demo video (maximum 5 minutes) showcasing the solution working in a simulation environment.
  • A 2–3 page concept note covering the problem, proposed approach, system architecture, and expected impact.
  • A link to the code repository (GitHub or similar).
  • Team details and the selected problem track.

Important: Entries must have a Technology Readiness Level (TRL) above 3.

Who Can Participate?

  • Undergraduate students from any recognised institution and discipline.
  • Early-stage startups working in robotics, IoT, embedded AI, or automation.
  • Teams comprising 2–5 members. Interdisciplinary and cross-institutional teams are encouraged.

Don't Miss Out!

This is your opportunity to push the boundaries of Physical AI, work on meaningful real-world challenges, and showcase your innovation on one of India's biggest entrepreneurship platforms.

Submission Deadline: 26th November 2026 | 11:59 PM

Grand Finale: 12th–13th December 2026 | E-Summit’26, IIT Bombay

Bring your ideas to life. Move beyond simulation. Build for reality!
